segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, second page's sanctum entry) to the Sanctum. Its Lua definition reaches the pre-map and post-map non-passwall barriers, the temple and morgue regions, the sanctum altar and high priest, fixed and random traps, objects, monsters, the up stair, and the down-teleport region. The seed was chosen without a search: every seed reaches the Sanctum from the menu.
